    Ashley Parker Angel Is Trading Boy Band Mania for Wellness — But He’s Bringing the Y2K Nostalgia With Him

    Ashley Parker Angel Is Trading Boy Band Mania for Wellness — But He’s Bringing the Y2K Nostalgia With Him

    Juliet Schroder
    September 1, 2026
    Juliet Schroder / Celeb Secrets
    Celebrities & Entertainment News
    48
    SHARES
    ShareTweet
    Listen to audio version of this article
    Sponsored by
    0:00 / 4:56
    Instaread

    If you grew up during the golden age of MTV‘s Making the Band, chances are Ashley Parker Angel’s frosted tips, bright blue eyes, and soaring vocals were plastered all over your bedroom walls. From topping the charts with O-TOWN’s iconic hit “All or Nothing” to commanding the Broadway stage for over 2,000 performances in smash hits like Wicked and Hairspray, Ashley spent two decades in the relentless spotlight.

    Today, the pop-culture icon turned wellness guru is channeling that exact same star power into a brand-new, game-changing venture — and he’s bringing all the Y2K nostalgia along for the ride.

    Discover more
    Movies
    Country Music
    Fashion

     Celeb Secrets caught up with Ashley back in May at his packed “High Level Happy Hour” pop-up event at GNC in Times Square, where fans lined up around the block to snap photos, chat health, and sing boy band karaoke with the heartthrob. The event celebrated the official national launch of his supplement company, High Level Science, now available exclusively at nearly 1,000 GNC stores nationwide.

    Pop Music

    Navigating world tours, non-stop Broadway schedules, and instant fame at 18 takes a heavy physical and mental toll. After years of battling anxiety, exhaustion, and the pressure of the entertainment industry, Ashley realized he had to revolutionize his approach to his health.

    Celebrities & Entertainment News

    “I’ve been America’s guinea pig,” Ashley tells Celeb Secrets exclusively. “I’ve taken so many things that didn’t work for me, that were disappointing… You open up Instagram or TikTok, and you have a thousand different things being advertised. So what do you take? Well, that’s the question that we wanted to solve with High Level Science — putting the science back into supplementation.”

    Discover more
    Celebrity
    Hobbies & Leisure
    Movie

    Co-founded alongside world-renowned master interventional cardiologist Dr. David G. Rizik, High Level Science was built to deliver research-driven, medical-grade formulas that eliminate confusing market fluff. Their flagship formulas, including High Level Man® and High Level Heart + Body + Mind™, feature pure, bioavailable ingredients like CoQ10, omega-3s, and vitamin E to target cellular energy and healthy aging.

    “Broadway’s the hardest gig I ever did. Eight shows a week, and you get one day off and you just sleep all day,” Ashley reflects. “If I hadn’t started prioritizing my physical, mental, and emotional health, I don’t think I would’ve been able to consistently beat out thousands of other performers for these coveted roles. When you exercise, you come up against an obstacle and you have to overcome it. It’s a great metaphor for life.”

    While High Level Science is grounded in cutting-edge clinical research, Ashley knows exactly how to connect with the fans who have stood by him since 2000. Enter the “Making The Brand” GNC Tour — a clever play on his MTV roots where Ashley is visiting over 700 GNC stores across the country to bring Y2K mall culture back to life.

    TV Networks & Stations

    “Us millennials get it because we already lived it, and now we’re reliving it again,” Ashley laughs, pointing out how late ’90s fashion, boy bands, and in-person hangouts are making a massive comeback. “There’s a big movement in our culture to get off your screen, to get off the couch, to go into the real world again… So by tapping into late ’90s, early 2000s mall culture, I’m going to GNCs, bringing back all those things that were happening around that Y2K movement.”

    And yes, that means full-blown karaoke sessions in the middle of GNC stores everywhere from Times Square to Las Vegas.

    Pop Music

    Ashley’s transition into wellness comes at a meaningful time of reflection. He recently appeared in Joey Fatone’s acclaimed ID/HBO Max docuseries, Boy Band Confidential, alongside legends like Lance Bass, AJ McLean, and Nick Lachey. The series pulls back the curtain on the triumphs and dark underbelly of late-’90s teen stardom, including their experiences with Lou Pearlman.

    “The feedback on the documentary has been amazing. It’s been all love,” Ashley shares. “As a culture, we’re talking more openly about so many things… This was the perfect time to share some of these stories — definitely things I had been through that I hadn’t talked about before. It’s been great to see the support from fans.”

    So, could a return to the stage ever be in the cards?

    “I do think being a performer is always gonna be in me, and life is long,” Ashley smiles. “I played Fiyero in Wicked, so I always say I’m gonna go back and play the Wizard someday in Wicked — like, in my 60s and 70s! But for this chapter right now, it’s all about High Level Science and really spreading this message of health and wellness.”

    For more on Ashley Parker Angel and High Level Science, make sure to watch our full interview below. Don’t forget to let us know if you’ve tried High Level Science and if you love it by either leaving a reaction at the bottom of the post or by sliding into our DMs on Instagram at @celebsecrets.

    LOUNGE’s New Drops Are Your Sign to Make Your Fall Wardrobe a Little Sexier This Season

    Juliet Schroder
    September 1, 2026
    LOUNGE

    Fall fashion is officially entering its cozy era — but that doesn’t mean your wardrobe has to sacrifice its flirt factor. In fact, we’re making a case for doing the exact opposite.

    Enter LOUNGE’s new Softfall collection, a dreamy lineup of elevated loungewear and everyday staples designed for those crisp-weather days when you want to be comfortable and look like you actually planned your outfit. Think rich chocolate brown, soft cream, sage green, flattering silhouettes and seriously luxe textures that make staying in feel just as chic as going out.

    And because one new arrival is never enough, LOUNGE is also bringing the romance with its Love Affair With LOUNGE collection, a separate new drop filled with intricate lingerie, delicate lace, satin details and feminine silhouettes that make a very convincing argument for treating your lingerie drawer like the fashion moment it deserves to be. So, yes, we’re embracing the fall uniform — but we’re doing it with a little more oomph.

    From the matching co-ords you’re going to practically live in to the lingerie sets that deserve their own spotlight, these are the LOUNGE new arrivals we’re eyeing for fall.

    Softfall Fitted-Waist Zip-Up Hoodie & Straight-Leg Joggers in Dark Chocolate

    $160

    Meet the hoodie that is about to make your old college sweatshirt feel extremely insecure. The Softfall Fitted-Waist Zip-Up Hoodie takes classic off-duty dressing and gives it a seriously flattering upgrade with a cinched rib-knit waistband, relaxed dropped shoulders and soft brushed-back fabric.

    The dark chocolate hue is basically autumn in clothing form, while the double-ended logo zip and silver hardware give this cozy staple a polished finish. You must pair it with the matching joggers for a monochromatic moment when you’re heading out for coffee, errands or whatever your version of “just popping out” entails.

    Softfall Oversized Cable-Knit Jumper in Cream

    $100

    There are sweaters you wear because it’s cold, and then there are sweaters that become your entire personality from September through March. This is the latter.

    Crafted from heavyweight 1080 GSM knit fabric, this oversized jumper features chunky cable-knit detailing, a cozy funnel neck and a ribbed waistband that keeps the relaxed silhouette feeling polished. It’s basically a warm hug with excellent taste.

    Wear it with jeans and boots, layer it over leggings or pair it with your favorite mini for a little contrast. Either way, this is the knitwear equivalent of having your life together.

    ContourSoft™ Cinch Zip-Up Jacket, Halter-Neck Top with Built-In Bra & Straight-Leg Leggings in Sage Green

    $180

    For the girl whose definition of “casual” still involves looking put together, meet your new favorite set.

    The ContourSoft™ Cinch Zip-Up Jacket is the jacket you throw on when you want everyone to think your outfit took 45 minutes when it actually took four, while the  halter-neck style top features an internal bra shelf, removable cups and underbust seam detailing for added structure and support. Meanwhile, the straight-leg leggings feature a universally flattering shape, no front seam and strategically placed stitching at the back for a sculpting effect. The sage green shade gives your activewear rotation a fresh update, while the sleek silhouette makes it easy to wear beyond the gym.

    Pair it with the matching leggings for a coordinated look that can take you from Pilates to coffee without missing a beat.

    Dahlia Corset Set in Navy

    $175

    If your lingerie drawer needs a little main-character energy, the Dahlia Corset Set has entered the chat. The three-piece set includes a matching underwired balcony bra, corset and thong, all finished with floral embroidery, eyelash lace, satin binding and romantic organza rosebud bows. The corset’s functional busk fastening and lace-up back create a beautifully cinched silhouette, while gold hardware adds an elevated finishing touch. It’s feminine, dramatic and absolutely not your basic Tuesday underwear.

    Felicity Intimates Set in Dark Chocolate

    $125

    Chocolate brown is having a major fashion moment, so naturally we’re bringing it into the lingerie drawer. The Felicity three-piece set pairs a balcony bra, thong and suspender with multi-tone floral embroidery, polka-dot tulle, eyelash lace and layered satin bows. Tiny rosebud details add an extra dose of romance, while gold logo hardware keeps everything feeling luxe. It’s giving soft girl with a secret, and we’re not asking questions.

    Zalia Slip Dress Set in Black

    $80

    Some lingerie is meant to be practical. The Zalia Slip Dress is meant to make an entrance.

    The satin slip dress features a low scooped back, sexy side slit and pops of black, red and pink embroidery, while satin bows and heart-shaped charms add a playful touch. Paired with its matching G-string, it’s the kind of set that instantly turns an ordinary night into a moment.
